digest.component_or_area: LLM gate telemetry and usage logging
propositions: Gate runs compute loop-vs-breadth telemetry (tool_calls, distinct counts, limits) via failure_usage() but discard it at the write, leaving only request counts persisted.
Gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set record nothing at all, forcing operators to re-run instrumented instances to answer tuning questions.
The success path never computes tool-call shape data, leaving successful runs untunable and asymmetric with failure rows.
Wall-clock duration and ticket_id are neither computed nor persisted for any gate run, blocking forensic matching and performance analysis.

Operators cannot distinguish a loop (few distinct tool signatures, many calls) from genuine breadth (many distinct signatures) from the durable record alone, requiring live re-runs to validate tuning advice.
Gate runs write to .rebar/usage.jsonl by default when inside a gate session, persisting run-shape fields and rendering them as a loop-vs-breadth diagnostic table via summarize().
